items.title: Giacomo Gates interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, March 29, 2015 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: It was David Hazeltine on piano, Peter Washington, Jim Rotundi on trumpet, and Ben Riley.

ctx.x: And there were several Monk tunes on the record that the record company cat, Marc Edelman from Sharp Nine Records. It was David Hazeltine on piano, Peter Washington, Jim Rotundi on trumpet, and Ben Riley. I show up and I see Ben Riley and I went wow. We’re doing “Epistrophy” with my lyrics, “Ask Me Now,” “Speed Ball,” a couple of tunes like that. And Ben Riley is looking at the list of songs. And he says to me, “you a tenor player?” I said, “no, I’m a singer.” Can I use French on this?
